inputs.unit: u in px, 2..12 (size / data-size attribute sets --ui-unit per subtree)
inputs.gap: gutter in u, 0..8 in 0.5 steps (gap attribute)

invariants: box-sizing: border-box everywhere; each owner deducts its own border once (pad = u − B).
Slots are fixed at 6u; density never shrinks slots, icons or type.
Lengths reach CSS through the variables styles/geometry.ts derives from the inputs; components never hard-code a length.
Change resolve.ts and styles/geometry.ts together, then regenerate docs/geometry.csv and tokens/dtcg/.

control.summary: Height 8u = 6u slot + 2·pad. Construction pattern [leading] [prefix] [contents] [suffix] [trailing]: icon slots 6u; the text run (prefix, label, suffix) has 0.5u beside another text part, 1u beside a slot, 2u at a bare edge. Font 10px + u. Icon = font + k·u (sm −0.5, md +0.5, lg +1.5), capped at the slot. Buttons with text: icon slots hug the glyph with a 2u outer margin, so edge-to-icon = edge-to-text.

field.summary: The control family applied to field hosts: the input control ([leading] [prefix] [editor] [suffix] [trailing]) and select trigger ([leading] [prefix] [value] [suffix] [chevron]) have pad = u − B and use the control text-run rule; the chevron is icon size sm.

btg.summary: Badge, tag and chip heights on the 12px + k·u ladder. Spacing uses a local unit u′ = height / 8: host 0.5u′ − B, slots height − u′, labels 1u′ on both sides (chip 1.5u′ at a bare edge), text parts 0.5u′ apart. Radius is concentric with the slot: (0.5u′ + slot / 3) × curvature, pill at height / 2 (the button's 1u + 6u / 3 = 3u). Icon slots hug the glyph inline with a 1u′ outer margin, so edge-to-icon equals edge-to-text (fill keeps the square slot).

choice.summary: Checkbox box (radius 1u), radio dot (circle) and switch track (capsule) inside a 6u leading slot. The indicator is the leading slot; the text run follows with a 0 bare end edge.

track.summary: 1u track, 4u thumb, full-height fills; the ratio arrives as --ui-ratio.

swatch.summary: 6u swatch; palettes join swatches with no gap and round only the outer corners.

swiper.summary: Paddles are control-family buttons; dots stretch when active.

container.summary: Levels composite 0.5u, group 1u, collection 2u, tile 3u, card 4u, panel 6u, region 8u, page 8u (+72rem max width). Gap defaults to the level padding; radius steps up per level and is 0 for panel, region and page.
